name: GCF Token Optimization for LLM Tool Responses
description: Fetches GitHub contributors, batches into an array, encodes to GCF (Graph Compact Format) for 53-71% fewer tokens, then decodes back to JSON losslessly. Uses the n8n-nodes-gcf community node.

source.path: OpenAI_and_LLMs/GCF Token Optimization for LLM Tool Responses.json
source.n8nName: GCF Token Optimization - Encode API Data, Decode Losslessly

setup: "GCF Decode (lossless)" (gcf.decode) only approximates the original; review it before relying on the result.
"GCF Encode" (gcf.encode) only approximates the original; review it before relying on the result.
Workflow secret GITHUB_TOKEN: GitHub token for api.github.com (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: "GCF Encode" (gcf.encode): GCF encode/decode approximated as base64 JSON Transform (no native GCF runtime).
"GCF Decode (lossless)" (gcf.decode): GCF encode/decode approximated as base64 JSON Transform (no native GCF runtime).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
